templates.projectReadme:
# {{modName}}

Minecraft {{mcVersion}} / Forge {{loaderVersion}} mod, generated by mcmodkit from a ModSpec.

## Build

```
gradlew.bat build      # Windows
./gradlew build        # macOS / Linux
```

The mod jar is written to build/libs/. Requires JDK {{javaVersion}}; the bundled Gradle wrapper ({{gradleWrapperVersion}}) downloads dependencies on first run.

{{TEXTURE_NOTES}}

## Regenerating

Files listed in the mcmodkit plan are managed and overwritten on regeneration; anything else in this
project is never touched. Re-run `mcmod gen <spec.json> -o .` from the framework repository.

public static final RegistryObject<Block> {{CONST_UPPER}} = BLOCKS.register("{{REG_NAME}}", () -> new Block({{SETTINGS}}));

notes: Forge 1.20.1 uses the pre-1.21 PLURAL datapack directories: data/<ns>/loot_tables/blocks/... and data/minecraft/tags/blocks/mineable/... The singular 1.21 names do not load here.
Requires Java 17 (JDK 17). The bundled Gradle 8.8 wrapper is required: ForgeGradle 6 is not compatible with Gradle 9.
Mappings are Mojang official (channel 'official'); API names are mojmap (net.minecraft.world.item.Item), not MCP/yarn.
Mod metadata lives in src/main/resources/META-INF/mods.toml; the @Mod annotated class is discovered by scanning, so mods.toml does not name it.
Version facts: Forge 1.20.1 recommended 47.4.10 (files.minecraftforge.net promotions_slim.json), ForgeGradle 6.0.54, Gradle 8.8 wrapper as shipped by the official 47.4.10 MDK.
Textures are not generated: add 16x16 PNGs under assets/<ns>/textures/{item,block}/<id>.png.

Compile-verified trap: ItemLike is net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike on 1.20.1 (verified with javap against the mapped Forge jar) and stays there on 1.21.1; net.minecraft.world.item.ItemLike does not exist on either version.
Compile-verified: ResourceLocation.fromNamespaceAndPath(namespace, path) exists in 1.20.1 and avoids the deprecated public ResourceLocation(String, String) constructor.

Registry lookups must not happen in register(): it runs from the mod constructor, before any RegisterEvent populates the DeferredRegister. TAB_ENTRIES therefore holds RegistryObject suppliers and resolves them lazily inside the creative-tab lambdas. Calling .get() there throws "Registry Object not present: <ns>:<id>" at load time.
